name: Orenthil Whisperwind
summary: Orenthil Whisperwind is a night elf resident of Teldrassil, commonly encountered resting under the boughs of Shadowglen. He serves as an welcoming liaison for rare travelers, presenting gifts sent across the world to newly arrived champions.

sections.title: A Friendly Face in Teldrassil
sections.body: Standing amidst the shaded terraces of Shadowglen, Orenthil Whisperwind offers a quiet welcome to fledgling adventurers beginning their journeys. While he remains modest and keeps mostly to himself beneath the canopy of the World Tree, he is notably tasked with greeting select travelers and delivering special companion creatures to those carrying rare tokens from abroad.

faq.answer: He is a night elf found in Shadowglen on Teldrassil. He serves as a welcoming figure for adventurers setting out into the boughs of the World Tree.

faq.q: Where can I find Orenthil Whisperwind?
faq.answer: Orenthil resides in Shadowglen, the night elf starting settlement within Teldrassil.
He offers the quest 'Welcome!', which allows travelers bearing special collector tokens to claim an exotic companion pet to accompany them on their journeys.
